svg.title: The same sentence sits beneath three separate workflows
svg.desc: Repeat only the shared sentence at equal weight below otherwise distinct columns. Its commonality must not visually merge their evidence access or responsibilities.

**Frame:** The three columns hold. Beneath each, the same sentence in the same weight, and
it is the only text the three lanes share.

**Caption:**
> NOT ENOUGH TIME. A LAYER OF MACHINERY ADDED ON PURPOSE. THE RISK UNDERSTOOD AND ACCEPTED.

**Qualification:**
> THE STAKES, THE ACCESS, AND THE DUTIES REMAIN AS UNEQUAL AS PAGE 085 DREW THEM.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — the shared structure is the project's reading. The
non-equivalence is mandatory and carries over from [page 085](085.md) unchanged.

", "title": "The same sentence sits beneath three separate workflows" } }
